name: Grilled Asian Pork Meatballs with Cucumber, Tomato & Carrot Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Zest and juice lime into a medium bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl with the lime juice.
Trim and mince green onions. Add half to the bowl with the lime juice (place remaining green onion in another medium bowl and set aside for the salad).
Add pork, fish sauce, and crushed red pepper to the bowl with the lime juice. Mix with your hands until well combined.
Place sesame seeds on a plate, spreading them out in an even layer.
Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

While the grill pan heats up, using a scant ¼-cup measure, form the pork mixture into 16 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long; place on the plate with the sesame seeds. Roll each meatball in the seeds to coat.

Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs to the pan and grill, rotating every 2-3 minutes, until browned and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, add oil, vinegar, fish sauce, sugar, pepper, and salt to the bowl with the remaining green onion. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel and medium dice cucumber; medium dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide meatballs and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
